title.zh: 分子构型 · 电子对互相躲开
title.en: Molecular Shapes · Electron Pairs Keeping Out of Each Other\

desc.zh: 中心原子周围的电子对彼此排斥，自己排成最分散的队形；水为什么弯、甲烷为什么是正四面体，都从这里来。
desc.en: Electron pairs around a central atom repel one another and settle into the most spread-out arrangement; that is why water is bent and methane is a regular tetrahedron.
